items.text: A choice field such as Seniority no longer looks empty when it holds a value that isn't in its list: it shows "Senior · not in the list" so you can pick the right option. Values written as an option's name or a common other word ("Head of", "C-level", "founder") are saved as that option, and lists your team made get "Add option" right in the picker.

Sales reporting's Live flow has a second view, Sales process: the companies open for the team to contact and the conversations that came in, joining into taken, handed to an account manager and customer, each number one click from its conversations, and By person with what each teammate did. Its numbers are the Team report's for the same period.

A sequence can now be set to "Only these senders". Outflare then never fills a shortage with someone else's mailbox, and one attached by hand in the sequencer shows under Needs attention with a one-click Detach, which now also works on a running EmailBison campaign.

Content: a brief now holds what a page was written to: who it is for, its outline, the questions it answers, what the pages that rank cover, and the facts it may state, each with its source. Questions the writer could not answer show above the text before you approve. A page can also list its other language versions, so your site can print hreflang.

Feedback inside Outflare: send a note about any page with a screenshot (paste, drop, choose or capture the page), kept private or shared as a thread in your team's Slack, whose replies show under it. Settings, Feedback lists every item with its status: New, Planned, Doing, Done or Won't do.

Brand search: follow any tracked competitor from a search box (before, only the first 40 were offered), with a link to your competitor list. Following, stopping and editing a brand's searches now show at once and save in the background, and searches are chips you add with Enter and remove with one click.

Sales reporting's Live flow now starts the email branch with Emails found: every address found for the period's companies, split into first email, follow-ups, support@ and not sent yet, which add up to it. When discovery is paused, a line above the tree says why.
